    """
    Checks if a set S of integers is sum-free under the condition x + y = z
    for x, y, z in S.
    Returns True if S is sum-free (no such triple exists), False otherwise.
    """
    S_list = list(S)
    n = len(S_list)
    
    # We iterate through all pairs (x, y) from S and check if their sum z = x + y is also in S.
    for i in range(n):
        x = S_list[i]

            y = S_list[j]
            z = x + y
            
            if z in S:
                # We found a solution x + y = z where x, y, z are in S.
                # The set is NOT sum-free.
